latest.title: Líder Estudantil Campus Builder AWS: De ideia a produto: a trilha do fundador universitário na AWS ( #awssbcl #ad )
latest.description: Fundar uma startup durante a faculdade é uma das decisões mais assimétricas que você pode tomar: o custo de errar é baixo, o aprendizado é brutal e o timing nunca mais será tão favorável. A AWS entende isso — e tem uma trilha específica para você. Este artigo é um mapa: começa no dia zero, antes de ter uma linha de código, e vai até o momento em que você tem seus primeiros usuários reais.

latest.title: Security Meets Reality: The Great Firewall
latest.description: The Great Wall protected the country for hundreds of years, and it remains one of the few human creations visible from space with the naked eye. In the digital world, its virtual counterpart continues that same idea of protection, shaping how information flows and what can pass through.

latest.title: Building Auditable RAG on Amazon Bedrock: A Five-Component Walkthrough
latest.description: A working five-component reference implementation for production context engineering on Amazon Bedrock. Walks through corpus, retrieval, injection, output, and enforcement against Spring PetClinic, using Titan Embeddings and Anthropic Claude. The output is a schema-validated PR; the enforcement layer proves the model used the ADRs retrieval handed it. Clone it, swap in your own corpus, and see why components 4 and 5 are what separate context engineering from RAG.

latest.title: Building a Database Performance Testing Tool With AI: The Honest Breakdown
latest.description: What does it look like to build a database performance testing suite almost entirely with AI? This article breaks down four test scenarios — N+1 detection, deadlock simulation, query regression tracking, and slow query gates — with real benchmark data and EXPLAIN plan diffs. But it's equally about the AI-assisted workflow itself: what the AI got right, what it got wrong, and what it actually means to "build" something when you spend more time reviewing than coding.

trending.title: AWS Summit Japan AI-DLCハッカソン書類審査結果
trending.description: AWS Summit Japan 2026 AI-DLCハッカソンの書類審査を実施しました。「人をダメにするサービス」という挑戦的なテーマに対して、想定を超える117チームからエントリーがありました。審査員全員がAIを使わない縛りで、創造性・ビジネス意図・Unit分解・ドキュメント品質の4観点から全チームを人間の目で評価し、15チームが書類選考を通過しました。5/30の予選会を経て上位5チームがAWS Summit Japan 2026決勝（幕張メッセ）へ進出します。
